Critically, none of these involve command substitution (`$(...)` or backticks), `eval`, `base64`, `curl`, `wget`, or any other code that would execute while the PKGBUILD is sourced. The `_release` assignment only concatenates other variables into a URL string; it performs no network activity. The only executable code in the file lives inside `package()`, which is NOT run by `makepkg --printsrcinfo` and is out of scope for this gate regardless.

The source URLs point to `https://github.com/google/keep-sorted/releases/download/...`, i.e. the package's own declared upstream. No data exfiltration or payload download/execution occurs during sourcing. Sourcing/parsing this PKGBUILD is safe.
</details>
